config.pulsehud.title: PulseHUD Settings
config.pulsehud.option.enabled.tooltip: Toggles the entire PulseHUD overhaul on or off.
config.pulsehud.option.theme.tooltip: Select your HUD style: Neon, Vanilla+, Cyberpunk, Minimal Dark, or RGB Reactive.
config.pulsehud.option.hud_scale.tooltip: Configures the size scale of custom HUD overlays.
config.pulsehud.option.base_opacity.tool: HUD transparency level during normal gameplay.
config.pulsehud.option.idle_opacity.tool: HUD transparency level when sitting idle/inactive.
config.pulsehud.option.animation_speed.t: Controls how quickly bars and slots transition.
config.pulsehud.option.glow_intensity.to: Modifies the strength of neon border outlines.
Transitions HUD colors smoothly based on player biome environment.
config.pulsehud.option.combat_mode.toolt: Enables neon red warning borders when recently in combat.
config.pulsehud.option.idle_mode.tooltip: Fades out HUD transparency when no inputs are detected.
config.pulsehud.option.low_health_vignet: Flashes screen borders red when heart container drops below 3 hearts.
config.pulsehud.option.speed_pulse.toolt: Shows sprinting acceleration chevron shapes inside the energy box.
config.pulsehud.option.water_overlay.too: Displays soft aquatic blue overlays when underwater.
config.pulsehud.option.show_rtc.tooltip: Integrates and renders custom timezones from the RealTimeClockUz mod.
config.pulsehud.option.widget_opacity.to: Controls background transparency of corner widgets.
config.pulsehud.option.reset_positions.t: Enable then Save to reset all widget and HUD element positions.
